title: Energy-Aware Deep Quantization for Ultra-Low Power Neuromorphic Accelerators
summary: Deploying deep neural networks onto edge neuromorphic hardware demands aggressive parameter compression. We develop a mixed-precision integer quantization framework that dynamically scales bit-widths between 2-bit, 4-bit, and 8-bit based on layer-wise gradient sensitivity. The framework reduces accelerator power dissipation by 62.3% on edge silicon while preserving 98.9% of full-precision ImageNet accuracy.
